metadata.title: Differentiation of tepui groupoids and the holonomy groupoid of singular foliations
metadata.abstract: Tepui groupoids are a generalization of Lie groupoids which allow the arrow space to be singular, as is the case for holonomy groupoids of singular foliations. We construct a Lie differentiation functor for a large class of tepui groupoids. When restricted to effective and source-connected tepui groupoids, this differentiation recovers the correspondence between holonomy groupoids and their underlying singular foliations.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 为允许箭空间奇异的tepui群胚建立Lie微分函子。
analysis.breakthrough: 在有效、源连通的子类上，微分对应恢复holonomy群胚与底层奇异叶状结构之间的联系。
analysis.limitations: 构造适用一个指定的大类tepui群胚，恢复对应另需有效和源连通条件。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
